basic_details.job_title: GAD Mizoram Group D Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Protocol & Hospitality Wing of the General Administration Department (GAD), Government of Mizoram, will fill 6 Group - D (P.E) posts at ₹11,990 a month (Monthly Remuneration). Candidates must buy the application form at the Protocol & Hospitality Wing, GAD, Old Secretariat Building-I (Assembly House opposite), Aizawl, during office hours and submit the filled form within 30 days from the advertisement, which works out to about 27 November 2026 (30 days from 28 October 2026). The notice is Advertisement No. 1 of 2026–2027.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days from the advertisement – about 27 November 2026 (30 days from 28 October 2026)

age_limit.details: The age limit is 18 to 35 years. On 01.08.2026, the applicant must not be younger than 18 years or older than 35 years.

qualification.details: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 6 vacancies. | Class-VIII (passed) and above. content_sections.heading: Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection process, and it prints the deadline as a 30-day period rather than a calendar date.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E) application is offline. The notice describes the process as follows: Address printed in the notice: Protocol & Hospitality Wing, GAD, Old Secretariat Building-I (Assembly House opposite), Aizawl. The notice does not mention the postal mode or what to write on the envelope. Candidates with questions can make enquiries at the same place where the application form is sold.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 6 vacancies. Class-VIII (passed) and above. Mizo language of Middle School Standard (Class-VIII and above). The age limit is 18 to 35 years. On 01.08.2026, the applicant must not be younger than 18 years or older than 35 years. Upper age limit relaxation follows the Government of Mizoram's age-limit Notification No.A.12011/1/2019-P&AR (GSW) dated 03.06.2019, published in the Mizoram Gazette Extraordinary, Issue No.375 dated 10.06.2019. The notice does not list the category-wise years of relaxation. The notice does not say how the fee is paid. For the eligibility details of the post, refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 Group - D (P.E) vacancies under the Protocol & Hospitality Wing, General Administration Department, Mizoram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E)?
faq.answer: The filled form must be submitted within 30 days from the advertisement, which is about 27 November 2026 (30 days from 28 October 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Class-VIII pass or higher, and Mizo language of Middle School Standard (Class-VIII and above).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E)?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years as on 01.08.2026. Upper age relaxation follows Notification No.A.12011/1/2019-P&AR (GSW) dated 03.06.2019.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E)?
Q6. What is the application fee for Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E)?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹150 for SC/ST/OBC candidates and ₹200 for General category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Mizoram GAD Group - D (P.E) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Buy the application form at Protocol & Hospitality Wing, GAD, Old Secretariat Building-I (Assembly House opposite), Aizawl, during office hours, fill it correctly and submit it at the address given within 30 days from the advertisement.

faq.answer: Enquiries can be made at the place where the application form is sold: the Protocol & Hospitality Wing, GAD, Old Secretariat Building-I (Assembly House opposite), Aizawl.
